name: Trinity The Holy
overview: Scripture reveals the triune nature of God through plural expressions and distinct persons working in unity. In Genesis, God speaks in the plural, saying, 'Let us make man in our image' and 'Behold, the man is become as one of us,' indicating a multiplicity within the Godhead. Isaiah portrays the LORD as holy and majestic, with the Spirit of the LORD resting upon the Messiah, emphasizing the distinct roles of the Father, Son, and Spirit. These passages collectively affirm the doctrine of the Holy Trinity as foundational to understanding God's nature and work.
